lines.raw: Step 1: Is it PHI?

lines.raw: Step 2: Who must protect it?
lines.say: Step 2: Who must protect it?

lines.raw: Ram's startup works on its PHI, so it is a business associate and signs a BAA before any data moves.

lines.raw: Step 5: Can we avoid PHI altogether?

lines.raw: Here is a quick table.

lines.raw: Keep PHI inside approved, secured systems. Don't: Put PHI in personal email, Slack, WhatsApp or Viber messages.
lines.say: Keep P H I inside approved, secured systems. Don't: Put P H I in personal email, Slack, WhatsApp or Viber messages.

lines.raw: Refer to records by a ticket or claim key inside the secure system. Don't: Paste screenshots of claim rows into tickets, chats or slide decks.
lines.say: Refer to records by a ticket or claim key inside the secure system. Don't: Paste screenshots of claim rows into tickets, chats or slide decks.

lines.raw: Use **synthetic** (fake) or de-identified data for development and testing. Don't: Copy production claims into a test database or your laptop.
lines.say: Use synthetic (fake) or de-identified data for development and testing. Don't: Copy production claims into a test database or your laptop.

lines.raw: Select only the columns and rows you need (minimum necessary). Don't: Run `SELECT *` and export everything to Excel "just in case".
lines.say: Select only the columns and rows you need (minimum necessary). Don't: Run SELECT * and export everything to Excel "just in case".

lines.raw: Use your own login; lock your screen when you step away. Don't: Share passwords or let a colleague use your account.
lines.say: Use your own login; lock your screen when you step away. Don't: Share passwords or let a colleague use your account.

lines.raw: Use only tools your company has approved for PHI (with a BAA in place). Don't: Paste PHI into a public AI chatbot or online formatter.
lines.say: Use only tools your company has approved for P H I (with a B A A in place). Don't: Paste P H I into a public A I chatbot or online formatter.

lines.raw: Delete extracts when the task is done, following policy. Don't: Leave old files in Downloads or shared folders.
lines.say: Delete extracts when the task is done, following policy. Don't: Leave old files in Downloads or shared folders.

lines.raw: Report a mistake **immediately**, even a small one. Don't: Hide a wrong email and hope nobody notices.
lines.say: Report a mistake immediately, even a small one. Don't: Hide a wrong email and hope nobody notices.
